rationale: Both turn the character scanner into a line-based renderer with good refactoring notes. B is much simpler and easier to follow. A single loop with one inList flag handles the line kinds as list item, header or paragraph, and every header, item and paragraph is opened and closed on the same line. B's emphasize helper replaces a marker pair only when both markers exist, which is more robust than the blind Replace calls, and it is parameterized cleanly by marker and tag. A builds a renderer struct with four state fields and five open/close methods. That machinery is heavier than the task needs and makes it harder to see what HTML a given line produces. A also keeps the brittle replace-first-occurrence emphasis logic unchanged. A is well documented, but B achieves the refactoring goal of readability with far less needless complexity.
